Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and the stakeholder list.

We can absolutely accommodate the broader panel. Two quick notes:
1) To give security and procurement what they need, we recommend a two-part session (platform + infra deep-dive, followed by procurement/security Q&A) — total ~90 minutes, or split into two 45-minute blocks if that works better for travel.
2) Karthik will lead the infra/security segment; Marissa will own procurement/contract items; Vivek will cover uptime/availability/SLA expectations.

Proposed windows from our side:
- Tue 22 Sep, 10:00–11:30 PDT (preferred)
- Thu 24 Sep, 08:00–09:30 PDT (alternate)

If one of those works for you and your leads (Elena & John), we'll send a calendar invite and an updated agenda. Attaching a draft agenda so everyone can add topics / blockers.

— Irene

Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Irene / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. From an infra/security perspective:
- We'll need roughly 30–40 minutes for the platform/integration and a separate 20–30 minute security deep-dive (threat model, network egress, KMS/HSM options).
- If procurement expects contract-level negotiation live, factor in another 15–20 minutes.

I can make Tue 22 at 10:00 PDT work. I'll also prep a short pre-read that summarizes our architecture, expected telemetry, and recommended quantization/throughput tradeoffs — that should streamline the live Q&A.

Attaching the pre-read for Elena / John's review.

— Karthik

Hi Priya — great, glad we're getting the right folks in the room. A couple of practical asks from procurement's side that often help:
- We usually surface SSO/KMS contracts and data retention language up-front; if John can share a short checklist, we can prep answers.
- If procurement wants to walk a draft SOW/quote live, I can have the pricing arm on standby, but we'd need the list of procurement items beforehand.

For scheduling, Irene's proposal looks good. To be explicit: we will plan for a 90-minute single session (platform + security + procurement) and leave some buffer for contract questions. Proposed confirmed slots from our side:
- Tue 22 Sep, 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Thu 24 Sep, 08:00–09:30 PDT

Priya — please confirm which slot works. If 22nd is good, we'll send a calendar invite with a breakout agenda and links (DocuSign for NDA if needed).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
